name: Backward Arm Circle
cardText:
Backward Arm Circle
Novice
1
Hold your arms out to your sides.
2
Rotate your arms backwards in small circles.

name: Forward Arm Circle
cardText:
Forward Arm Circle
Novice
1
Hold your arms out to your sides.
2
Rotate your arms forward in small circles.

name: Ring Rear Delt Fly
cardText:
Ring Rear Delt Fly
Intermediate
1
Stand facing rings and grab the handles.
2
Step forward so that your body is in a plank position, with your arms straight and your body in a straight line from your head to your heels.
3
Keeping your arms straight, slowly lift your arms out to the side, keeping them at the same height as your shoulders. Your body should form a "T" shape.
